scope: Synthetic research only; production retains anomaly-stack-v2 unless independently validated real outcomes exist
selection: Highest minimum validation AP over motif and surge across all available 100K, 300K and 1M development reports, subject to discrimination AP >= v2 - 0.01 on every development dataset; lexical candidate tie break. Freeze candidate and report hashes before final generation/evaluation.
tuning: No search beyond registered candidates; fixed depth/leaf/rate and random_state=42
splits: Chronological reference first 80% fit, remaining 20% calibration, separate validation and final partition. Each reserved final dataset fits only its own earlier reference: forward-case retraining, NOT transfer of frozen model weights.
scenario_family_holdout: benign_payroll transactions excluded from supervised fitting and calibration; reported separately if represented in evaluation

stress_parameters.missing_network_prevouts: Every fifth transaction lacks endpoint/ASN/country; every twentieth resolved input is unknown
stress_parameters.timing_endpoint_skew: Quantize observed times to 60 seconds; every fourth transaction shares endpoint and ASN 0; every twentieth endpoint is unknown

uncertainty: 100 deterministic cluster-bootstrap replicates, group by labelled scenario episode when available, otherwise recipient entity, otherwise independent transaction. Report conditional AP/P100 percentile intervals and cluster count; never row-bootstrap a linked episode.
acceptance: Report per-dataset, mean and worst case. Any missing metric/class, failed target or regression retains v2. Synthetic superiority alone never authorizes production promotion.
final_use: Exclusive dataset reservation and exclusive evaluation marker; no final retuning or rerun after observing final outcomes
limitations: Same generator with independent seeds and registered construction/stress variants is not an independently authored generator or real-world validation. Entity/time/scenario split audit must be reported, not assumed.
